organization: Ministry of Climate Crisis and Civil Protection
identified_problem: The ministry's official portal publishes daily wildfire-risk maps and civil-protection guidance, and recently announced compensation payments to Chios businesses for 2025 wildfires, demonstrating active, ongoing disaster-management responsibilities tied to Greece's wildfire and flood exposure.
climate_exposure: National responsibility for coordinating Greek civil protection against wildfire, flood, heat, and other natural hazards across all regions including Thessaly, Attica, Rhodes, and Crete.
potential_pain: Limited real-time situational awareness and cross-agency coordination during fast-evolving wildfire and flood events strain evacuation and resource-deployment decisions.
evidence: Talaix wildfire and flood monitoring layers, SMS alert integration, and evidence-labelled historical event reports for the 2023 Thessaly floods and 2023–2024 Greek wildfires.
recommended_message: Offer real-time hazard monitoring and evidence-labelled event intelligence to support national civil-protection coordination and public alerting.
fit_score: The lead agency for Greek disaster response with an active public alerting mandate and documented recent fire events; high-value user for monitoring and alert capabilities.

interactions.summary: Identified via official-source research; signal: portal displays daily fire-risk map for 24 August 2026 and press releases on 2025 Chios wildfire business-compensation scheme.
